verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's changelog documents an OpenAPI import path that maps spec tags into folders, which shows that importing an OpenAPI spec produces organized collections of requests. A separate entry notes simultaneous imports of collections and environments. The evidence is a single changelog line rather than dedicated import documentation. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on the OpenAPI import flow (supported versions, how requests, parameters and bodies are generated), and independent or hands-on corroboration of import quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import an OpenAPI spec to generate requests and collections

citations.quote: Use tags as folders when importing from OpenAPI.
Support simultaneous imports of collections and environments.
